sections.Profile:
The "Regatta" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on August 5, 1955, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin. This machine features two flippers, two pop bumpers, five passive bumpers, two slingshots, and two rollover buttons.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1955
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
